digest.component_or_area: tickets repository storage and reconciler infrastructure
propositions: Execute a one-time atomic force-push rewrite of the tickets branch to reclaim 92% of repository size after all writers are quiesced and pre-rewrite correctness assertions pass on a scratch clone

Guard against epoch-blind stale writers by deploying an epoch-mismatch refusal probe using the exact refreshed host runtime and verifying successful deployment/vote before and after the rewrite window
Converge all 48 local worktrees and the persistent review-bot clone over SSM to the post-rewrite tickets tip, then re-pin identity.enforce_since via Gerrit to register the new commit map epoch value

Verify non-resurrection by confirming old-tip ancestry is false post-window and no default-fetched ref contains the old tip as an ancestor, combined with post-write size-pack growth below 1 MB threshold

Require operator-attested confirmation of zero active sessions, all rebar-mcp servers stopped, and successful post-enable reconciliation (dry/live passes with zero mutations errors and drift_total=0) before declaring the reclaim complete
Validate repository integrity via rebar fsck returning zero repairable findings and exactly four intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED audit records post-merge
